C5.what: a jev.metrics.v1 report missing any mandatory metric, the chance of its K or the n of its cut

C6.what: a reading that contradicts its own numbers — an interval claim the figures do not support, or a hypothesis eliminated AS A CAUSE in an artifact whose own R9 field says it establishes none

C7.exempt: a cited third-party number (citation: true, or who + source)
C7.scope: the pilot only: the historical gates measured before the suite existed are what it replaces, and are not retro-flagged
C7.what: a gate of the pilot (PILOT_TASKS) that publishes a quality metric with no jev.metrics.v1 report in its directory — a figure computed by hand instead of by eval.metrics_suite.report

controls.carried_not_invented: both are measured elsewhere and handed to report(); a report without one is incomplete and check() fails it
controls.distinct: these are TWO properties and the 2026-09-24 measurement separates them: the scores follow the option text under permutation and the model still misses the decisive change. A green permutation check is not evidence of tracking and never stands in for one
controls.permutation_invariance: permuting the offered candidates leaves each candidate's weight where it was, realigned by id — the #T-option-text control
controls.tracking: changing the decisive fact in the state, or the question asked of it, changes the answer

suite.counterfactual: joint success by variant_group — a group with exactly one half right scores 0
suite.ranking_and_abstention: published apart and side by side: `ranking` is the forced choice with `unknown` out of the race, `abstention` the decision over [K + 1] with coverage and precision among the answered. Neither is a headline alone
suite.softmax_semantics: softmax weights are RELATIVE to the candidates offered on that row: they redistribute over the K columns that were shown and say nothing about the probability that an answer is true in the world. Offering a different candidate set moves every weight

verdict.r4: this verdict is about the reporting code and the artifacts on disk on 2026-09-26; it transfers to no model regime
verdict.reading: the reporting is fixed, not the model. Nothing here measures a checkpoint and no accuracy of ours is published in this artifact: what it records is that a figure now travels with its n, its K, its chance and its interval, that ranking and abstention are reported apart, and that a sentence contradicting those numbers is an ERROR. Whether the pilot's numbers improve is a different measurement and this gate makes no claim about it
